result.summary: This draft RFC PR enables -Wunused and related compiler warnings project-wide, along with the mechanical fixes needed to make the build clean under those flags (renaming/removing unused parameters, marking constants [[maybe_unused]], converting some static const to inline constexpr). Several of the seven commits are explicitly marked [[nomerge]] because they depend on companion PRs to upstream subtrees (minisketch, libmultiprocess, leveldb-subtree). The author has already split a more scoped, mergeable subset into #36275 based on review feedback.
result.problem: The project has had a string of manual dead-code removal PRs recently, and one case (#36137) where code was mistakenly believed unused but had actually just been forgotten to be wired in. Turning on -Wunused in CI would catch both classes of issue automatically going forward, benefiting all contributors and reviewers who currently rely on manual grep-style code audits.

result.card: This draft RFC from a Bitcoin Core maintainer enables -Wunused and related compiler warnings across the build, paired with mechanical fixes (dropping unused parameter names, marking constants [[maybe_unused]], converting some static const to inline constexpr) needed to make the build warning-clean. The stated motivation is a string of recent manual dead-code-removal PRs and one case (#36137) where new code was mistakenly believed unused when it had actually just been forgotten to be wired in, so this would catch both classes automatically in CI going forward. Several commits are explicitly marked [[nomerge]] pending companion PRs to the minisketch, libmultiprocess, and leveldb-subtree repositories, and CI is currently failing, so the PR is not fully reviewable as-is. Reviewer maflcko suggested a narrower initial flag set and splitting out the parameter-warning changes; the author agreed and already split a more actionable slice into #36275. Only in the build category, since all other areas' edits are purely mechanical call-site fallout from the new warnings.
